decisions.reason: A safety shoe line fits the core business and costs little to keep in an in-house, flexible production system, and one year on the market is too early to resolve uncertainty about its value.
The comfort insole is a low-cost accessory option that complements shoe sales, but it may overlap with the firm's other insoles and could later be consolidated.
The supportive insole is cheap to maintain and supports the firm's foot-measurement and tailored-solution offering, so keeping the option open is sensible while demand is still uncertain.
The ergonomic series has its own page, which signals commitment and growing relevance, and its prospects are still unfolding, so abandoning it now would be premature.
Firefighter boots open a specialized segment with certification sunk costs already paid, so the option is worth keeping until tender results reveal its value.
As the flagship shown on the home page, the moulded insole is a strategic option the firm is actively scaling, and the early results give no reason to abandon it.
